name: account-payables
description: Root-level dispatch scripts. Each script is a thin wrapper around a per-workspace toolchain (pip/pytest/ruff for backend, pnpm for frontend, flutter for mobile). Treat this package.json as a task runner — there are no JS dependencies at root.

scripts.//-- setup --: One-time bootstrap of all three workspaces. install:backend pip-installs into the ACTIVE Python env — source backend/.venv/bin/activate first (create with python3 -m venv backend/.venv). Docs: docs/getting-started.md.
scripts.install:all: pnpm run install:backend && pnpm run install:frontend && pnpm run install:mobile
scripts.//-- dev --: Orchestrators: dev = backend :8000 + frontend :7777, one Ctrl-C stops both; dev:all = db:up (core services) then dev; dev:full = services:up (core + every opt-in profile) then dev. dev:backend needs the backend venv activated; dev:mobile needs a device/emulator and is NOT part of dev.
scripts.dev: bash -c 'trap "kill 0" EXIT; (cd backend && exec python main.py) & (cd frontend && exec pnpm dev) & wait'
scripts.dev:all: pnpm run db:up && pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:full: pnpm run services:up && pnpm run dev
scripts.//-- db --: Core services via backend/docker-compose: Postgres :5432, Redis :6379, MinIO :9000. Prerequisite for seed/migrate/test:backend. db:reset drops volumes. Docs: backend/docs/docker.md.
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.//-- idp --: Local IdPs (opt-in idp profile): Keycloak OIDC+SAML SSO :8088, Authentik SCIM :9002. The *:seed scripts point the acme tenant at them (backend venv required). Docs: docs/local-sso-keycloak.md, docs/local-sso-saml.md.
scripts.idp:up: cd backend && docker compose --profile idp up -d keycloak authentik-server authentik-worker
scripts.idp:down: cd backend && docker compose stop keycloak authentik-server authentik-worker authentik-postgres authentik-redis
scripts.idp:logs: cd backend && docker compose logs -f keycloak authentik-server authentik-worker
scripts.//-- aws --: LocalStack :4566 (opt-in aws profile) emulating SQS/SES/CloudWatch/S3-ObjectLock; point the backend at it via AP_AWS_ENDPOINT_URL. Docs: docs/local-aws-localstack.md.
scripts.aws:up: cd backend && docker compose --profile aws up -d localstack
scripts.aws:down: cd backend && docker compose stop localstack
scripts.aws:logs: cd backend && docker compose logs -f localstack
scripts.//-- ai --: Ollama :11435 (opt-in ai profile) for the ollama extraction + assistant adapters; ollama:pull <model> fetches a model into the container. Docs: backend/docs/local-ai-testing.md.
scripts.ollama:up: cd backend && docker compose --profile ai up -d ollama
scripts.ollama:down: cd backend && docker compose stop ollama
scripts.ollama:logs: cd backend && docker compose logs -f ollama
scripts.ollama:pull: cd backend && docker compose exec ollama ollama pull
scripts.//-- stripe --: stripe-mock :12111 (opt-in payments profile) for the stripe_treasury payment adapter. Docs: backend/docs/payments.md.
scripts.stripe:up: cd backend && docker compose --profile payments up -d stripe-mock
scripts.stripe:down: cd backend && docker compose stop stripe-mock
scripts.stripe:logs: cd backend && docker compose logs -f stripe-mock
scripts.//-- mail --: Mailpit (opt-in mail profile): SMTP sink :1025 + web inbox :8025 for the smtp email adapter (AP_EMAIL_PROVIDER=smtp). Docs: docs/local-email-mailpit.md.
scripts.mail:up: cd backend && docker compose --profile mail up -d mailpit
scripts.mail:down: cd backend && docker compose stop mailpit
scripts.mail:logs: cd backend && docker compose logs -f mailpit
scripts.//-- services --: Everything at once — core (Postgres/Redis/MinIO) + all opt-in profiles (idp/aws/ai/payments/mail). services:reset also drops volumes.
scripts.services:up: cd backend && docker compose --profile idp --profile aws --profile ai --profile payments --profile mail up -d
scripts.services:down: cd backend && docker compose --profile idp --profile aws --profile ai --profile payments --profile mail down
scripts.services:logs: cd backend && docker compose --profile idp --profile aws --profile ai --profile payments --profile mail logs -f
scripts.services:reset: cd backend && docker compose --profile idp --profile aws --profile ai --profile payments --profile mail down -v && docker compose --profile idp --profile aws --profile ai --profile payments --profile mail up -d
scripts.//-- seed & migrate --: Demo data + Alembic migrations. Need core services up (db:up) and the backend venv activated. seed creates 2 demo tenants; migrate:all = control plane + every per-tenant ap_<slug> DB. Docs: backend/docs/database.md.
scripts.migrate:all: pnpm run migrate && pnpm run migrate:tenants
scripts.//-- build --: Production builds. Frontend is adapter-static (GitHub Pages) — no SSR.
scripts.//-- check --: Static analysis + formatting per workspace: ruff (backend — venv required), svelte-check (frontend), flutter analyze (mobile). check = lint.
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:mobile
scripts.//-- test --: Test suites per surface: pytest (backend — venv + core services required), Playwright e2e (frontend), flutter test (mobile). test:scim/test:saml need the local IdPs up + seeded (idp:up then scim:seed/saml:seed). test:scripts validates this file's script targets.
scripts.test:scim: cd frontend && pnpm exec playwright test --config=tests-e2e/playwright.config.ts scim/
scripts.test:saml: cd frontend && pnpm exec playwright test --config=tests-e2e/playwright.config.ts saml/
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:mobile
